rules.rule: Reports only: no source edit, no fix, no plan file
must: it edits no source, applies no fix, and writes no plan

rules.rule: style runs only through review, never as its own worker
must: `style` is never a dimension of its own

rules.rule: No target audits the working diff; `all` audits the module
must: empty — the packages the working diff touches
`all` — every package of the current module

rules.rule: Broad target with no budget: propose and stop before dispatch
must: Nothing is dispatched before the answer

rules.rule: The audit splits all work; no worker fans out
must: A subagent cannot dispatch subagents, so the audit splits all the work and no worker fans out

rules.rule: Default reshape: editable modules only, never the target's own packages
must: reshape the editable modules the target imports
The default never picks a package of the target module itself

rules.rule: cover and doc grade Should-fix or Nit, never Blocker
must: Nit when only statement lines are uncovered

rules.rule: One finding per concern across dimensions; the measuring dimension owns it
must: same concern is one finding, with the higher grade, naming both dimensions

rules.rule: Fix order is dependency order, not severity
Counts read off the finished report
must: Read every count off the finished report
